_source: USD per million tokens at Anthropic API list prices (current models from the claude-api skill model table, cached 2026-06-24; older models from Anthropic's published pricing). Cache writes = 1.25x input (5m) and 2x input (1h). Long-context surcharges some older models charge above 200K input tokens are not modelled. Confirm on the Anthropic pricing page before relying on the dollars.
_note: Keys are canonical model ids: provider prefixes and suffixes (us.anthropic.…-v1:0, @20250929, -20251001, [1m]) are stripped and old names like claude-3-5-sonnet become claude-sonnet-3-5 before lookup. A model missing here is priced like the nearest version of its family (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, mythos) and flagged as estimated in the report. Add a line to price a new model exactly.

_modifiers._note: Multipliers on every token price of a call, from the model version "from" on. Global routing is list price on both platforms. bedrock_regional: a Bedrock inference profile other than global. before anthropic. in the model id (us., eu., apac., jp., au., us-gov. and any new one). api_regional: the call's usage says an inference_geo other than "global" (the Claude API's "us" today). A model's own "fast" below multiplies calls whose usage says speed "fast" (fast mode; cache prices scale with it).

_aliases._note: Model ids that name no model, mapped to a canonical id, e.g. a Bedrock application inference profile: "arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-2:123456789012:application-inference-profile/abc123": "claude-opus-4-8". modelOverrides in your Claude Code settings are read the same way without being listed here.
